# Immutable draw.io source fixtures

These files are unmodified upstream source from
[jgraph/drawio-desktop](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/tree/2edf9fb97eff9bd94bdda33abfe1ee9e7f7bb55e),
commit `2edf9fb97eff9bd94bdda33abfe1ee9e7f7bb55e`, package version 31.7.0.
Copyright remains with the upstream authors. Upstream package metadata specifies
GPL-3.0-only; the exact upstream LICENSE is included.

`source_manifest.json` two directories above records Git blob IDs, exact byte
lengths and SHA-256 hashes. Source was retrieved from GitHub's contents API at
that immutable commit on 2026-11-05 Europe/Berlin (2026-11-04 UTC). The preload was
also compared with the preserved research input at research commit
`ee49dbf5fd830304159a300c7b498f94ac340fa5`.

The main source is retained as inert audit input. The source auditor never
executes it, imports its dependencies, starts the application, or loads its
configuration. The Windows native feasibility harness may separately execute
the unmodified preload against an expressly identified experimental facade.
This does not establish a Windows package-image trust root or approve Route D.
